source: Bony to Beastly workouts PDF (personal-use reference). Workout sheets: pages 24–38.

notes.workouts_per_week: Each phase is three full-body workouts per week (Day 1, Day 2, and Day 3). The overview describes training roughly every other day, with one extra rest day that is treated as mandatory.
notes.phase_durations: Each of Phases 0–4 is five weeks long. After Week 5, Day 3 of a phase, go straight to Week 1, Day 1 of the next phase — there is no planned week off in between. The first week of a new phase is written as a lighter deload relative to the hard finish of the previous phase.
notes.stay_within_2_reps_of_target: Aim to land within two repetitions of the number on the sheet. If the target is 10, doing 8 with a heavier weight or 12 with a lighter weight is acceptable.
notes.circuits_optional: Circuits (pairing exercises and alternating sets) are optional. They save time and raise the cardiovascular demand but are not required for muscle growth. If the gym is busy or you are using a single pair of adjustable dumbbells at home, do straight sets instead and double the listed rest time.
notes.rest_plus_sign: Rest times are written with a plus sign (for example 30+ sec or 1+ min). Treat them as a minimum: rest at least that long, and longer if you need it, so that strength stays high. A listed rest of 0+ sec means there is no required rest; you may go straight on or pause if you need to.
notes.exercise_order: Exercises are ordered from most important at the top to least important at the bottom. If you have to shorten a session, skip work from the end of the workout.
notes.how_to_run_a_circuit: Within a circuit, alternate the paired lifts set by set (lift A set 1, rest, lift B set 1, rest, lift A set 2, and so on), then move to the next circuit.
notes.logging: Log the load and the repetitions you complete in each set (for example 10 x 50). Barbell loads should include the bar (a standard Olympic bar is 20 kg / 45 lb).
notes.repeating_phases: If you finish a phase and do not yet feel confident with the lifts, you may repeat that entire phase from week 1. Do not stretch or shorten a phase mid-way. Phase 0 may be repeated up to three times before you move on to Phase 1.
notes.coming_back_after_a_break: If you time off mid-phase, restart at the beginning of the phase you left.
notes.tempo: Lift the weight quickly and with intent; lower it under control. There is no need to count seconds on the way down.
